completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1956/ra_1506_1956.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en:
Section eight of Republic Act Numbered Five hundred and eighty-eight, as amended by Republic Act Numbered Seven hundred twenty-six, Republic Act Numbered Nine hundred and fifty-eight, Republic Act Numbered One thousand ninety-one, and Republic Act One thousand two hundred eighty, is further amended to read as follows:
"Sec. 8. The provisions of this Act shall take effect upon its approval."

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 16, 1956.
